resources.string: Handpicked local roasteries and vintage coffee spots around the city.
A nostalgic, vintage-style coffee shop famous for its signature iced brown sugar coffee and freshly baked pastries.
A premium local roastery dedicated to showcasing authentic single-origin coffee beans from all across the Indonesian archipelago.
A quiet and cozy hidden gem spot, perfect for catching up on remote work or enjoying a peaceful afternoon espresso.
Top culinary destinations ranging from historic traditional foods to fine dining.
Offers a high-end dining experience featuring refined local Indonesian and South-East Asian seafood cuisines in a cultural pavilion setup.
An ultra-modern rooftop restaurant serving incredible Nikkei cuisine (Japanese-Peruvian fusion) alongside breathtaking panoramic skyscraper views.
A legendary culinary institution serving authentic beef soup made with a rich, aromatic coconut milk broth since the 1940s.
Fun, educational, and active theme spots to keep the little ones fully entertained.

An interactive art venue featuring colorful, retro rooms designed for roller-skating, canvas painting, and taking creative family photos.
